_help: The list behind index.html. Groups have a section (Game or Aircraft); every aircraft is its own group, with a family (e.g. Airbus A330 / A340). Each row: name, optional plane, and a state per app: done (green), doing (yellow, being worked on), no (not there yet), na (not needed in that app), unknown (not checked). Optional: note, who (e.g. {"fly": "Eric"}). Requests from the page are GitHub issues labelled 'request' (see CLAUDE.md). Keep it valid JSON: python3 -m json.tool board.json >/dev/null

features.name: World map: 16,000 airports, cities, real runways
Market, hangar, buying, leasing, used planes
Timetables, slots and the slot market
Airport shares, runways, terminals, own airports
Local time at each airport, day and night
Save files shared between web and Rust
Approach, runway and PAPI lights from far
Moving parts: flaps, control surfaces, reversers, wing bending
Engine sounds (synth + recorded) and the F6 mixer
Cockpit sounds: real GPWS words, callouts, tones, cabin
features.note: Rust: callouts as text only. Per plane under Aircraft

features.name: Hand flying: 16 types, stalls, trim, limiter (L)
features.note: Web opens the Fly page (✈ Fly / P). Per plane under Aircraft

features.name: Start screen: gallery, airport, livery, time, wind
Cockpit views on Ctrl + arrows (captain, middle, first officer, overhead)
No bank limit: a steep turn costs g
Radios: ATIS, tower calls, transponder, TCAS
Panels as modules you can move or copy to other planes
Breakable parts: wingtips, wings, elevators, tumbling
Wing strikes, fuselage break-up, fireballs, debris
Fire trails, burning pieces, Concorde reheat
